purpose: new independent acceptance candidate after confirmed Tavily account quota exhaustion and authorized key rollover
hypothesis: With the same R163 code and a verified non-exhausted Tavily account, the immutable cohort will regain live retrieval evidence, finish 30/30, and meet all product thresholds in one execution.

cohort.selection_rule: every frozen question exactly once; no R164 or earlier state, saved states, rerun, best-of, silent exclusion, or cross-candidate splicing

decision_rules.pass: One merged exact-once artifact has 30/30 done, three live fidelity layers, no saved states, evidence_reachable_rate >= 0.60, orphaned_sub_questions == 0, and false_premise_failed == 0.
decision_rules.candidate_passes: Publish the runner JSON as sole product proof and proceed to provider-free F15.
decision_rules.candidate_fails: Preserve the experiment and return to conditional F13; never splice candidates.

provider_change.reason: R164 confirmed HTTP 432 quota exhaustion on the prior Tavily account
provider_change.replacement_probe: HTTP 200 with a non-empty search result

stop_conditions: sum of shard ledgers reaches CNY 25
credential material would enter tracked or run artifacts
exact-once or live-fidelity configuration is invalid before execution
rollback: Preserve all results and terminal states; no failed-case rerun or supersession on unchanged code.
